purpose: Verify that sl-work is a thin interactive compatibility adapter over sl-plan and sl-run, preserves older unattended callers deliberately, and isolates HTML and knowledge-work compatibility instead of treating the old skill as the primary code engine.
non_purpose: This suite does not re-evaluate sl-run implementation, reviewer, delivery, or closeout behavior and does not evaluate the full legacy HTML or knowledge-work workflow.

variance_protocol.pass_threshold: all must-tier terms and every behavioral condition pass in at least 2 of 3 runs

grading_pipeline.stage_1: Case-insensitive expected-term recall; every must-tier term is required.
grading_pipeline.stage_2: Behavioral grading against every expected_context statement and the prohibited workflow-engine reconstruction.

evals.name: markdown-plan-routes-interactively
evals.prompt: You receive `/sl-work plan:docs/plans/retry-plan.md profile:bug`. Explain the route and authority boundary.
expected_context: The response invokes sl-run directly with the exact plan, interactive mode, and profile token.
It does not implement, dispatch a reviewer fleet, or ship from the wrapper, and it preserves explicit engineer review before delivery.

ground_truth.behavior: Markdown plan routes directly to interactive sl-run

evals.name: description-plans-before-running
evals.prompt: Use sl-work for the bare request: add a cache invalidation metric. No plan exists yet. What happens?
expected_context: The response plans the software task first, then passes the returned canonical Markdown path to sl-run in interactive mode.
It does not directly implement the bare prompt or select the newest plan by guesswork.

evals.name: state-resume-stays-direct
evals.prompt: You receive `/sl-work state:/tmp/super-looper/sl-run/demo/run-state.json`. State the route and what does not repeat.
expected_context: The response resumes the exact sl-run state interactively.
It does not invoke sl-plan or initialize another run.

evals.name: older-unattended-token-is-preserved
evals.prompt: An older caller invokes `/sl-work plan:docs/plans/x.md mode:unattended`. Do you silently make it interactive? Give the direct replacement guidance and route.
expected_context: The response preserves unattended policy when forwarding to sl-run rather than silently asking interactive questions.
It names lfg or sl-run mode:unattended as the direct replacement for future callers.

ground_truth.behavior: older unattended policy is preserved with replacement guidance

evals.name: html-does-not-masquerade-as-canonical
evals.prompt: You receive `/sl-work docs/plans/legacy-plan.html`. May you pass it to sl-run as though it were canonical Markdown?
expected_context: The response does not pass HTML to sl-run as canonical Markdown and selects only the isolated compatibility path available on the host.
It recommends output:md followed by sl-run as the direct route for future code plans.

ground_truth.behavior: HTML uses isolated compatibility and never masquerades as canonical Markdown
